name: If two plane mirrors are placed parallel to each other, the number of images formed of an object kept between them is:
description:
Question:

If two plane mirrors are placed parallel to each other,
the number of images formed of an object kept between them is:

(a) Infinite
(b) Zero
(c) One
(d) Two

Answer: (a) Infinite (अनंत) ✅

Formula:

Number of Images (n)

n = (360°/θ) - 1

Where θ = angle between mirrors

Special Case:

θ = 0° (Parallel Mirrors)

n = (360/0) - 1

⇒ ∞ (Infinite)

Hence,
Two parallel plane mirrors produce infinite images.

TRICK:

"Mirror hue Parallel,
Images hue Eternal."

Yaad Rakho:

0° → Infinite Images

60° → 5 Images

90° → 3 Images

120° → 2 Images

180° → 1 Image

One-Line Exam Trick:

"Parallel Mirrors = Infinite Images"
